title: Aid Stations — Western States 100: crew access and pacer change
claims: The checkpoint chart has dedicated Crew Access and Pacer Change columns marking which stations crews may enter and where a pacer may join the runner.
Pacers may join only at designated pacer-change stations on the official chart.
Many checkpoints are restricted to race officials because of limited parking and the need to keep narrow access roads clear.

claimVerification.note: Checkpoint 表含 Crew Access 与 Pacer Change 两列，逐站标注 Yes/No。
Pacer Change 列仅在指定站点为 Yes；其余站点 No。
Crew Access 列多处 No；FAQ 段说明停车受限与救援通道要求。
